sources.title: Florence-2 - maestro
sources.snippet: Florence-2 is a lightweight vision-language model open-sourced by Microsoft under the MIT license. It offers strong zero-shot and fine-tuning capabilities for tasks such as image captioning, object detection, visual grounding, and segmentation.

sources.snippet: Vection Labs' Maestro-2-9B-Preview is a 9.65 billion parameter dense multimodal model built on the Qwen3.5 architecture, designed for engineering tasks. It features native thinking capabilities, agentic software engineering, and genuinely multimodal input processing for images and video. sources.title: GitHub - roboflow/maestro: streamline the fine-tuning process for ...
sources.snippet: maestro is a streamlined tool to accelerate the fine-tuning of multimodal models. By encapsulating best practices from our core modules, maestro handles configuration, data loading, reproducibility, and training loop setup. It currently offers ready-to-use recipes for popular vision-language models such as Florence-2, PaliGemma 2, and Qwen2.5-VL.
